note: Family-owned RV park on Lake Oelwein next to Oelwein City Park, NE Iowa: gated, quiet and family-oriented. Swim beach, kayak/canoe, mini and frisbee golf, pickleball. Not designed for tents; pop-ups allowed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $50 (plus weekly/monthly), full hookups 30/50, GS + Passport America (operator page), reservable on the operator's request form; season May 1-Oct 15, showers/laundry/WiFi added. Waterfront lead down lakefront -> lakeview. Passes the gate at exactly $50.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): posted '2026 Camping Rates Nightly $50.00' plus 7% tax, which sits ON the US$50 line, not over it; Good Sam Park (entry, GS directory) and the operator names Good Sam and Passport America (not on holiday weekends), so $45 for GS members; RV Life 2026 reviewers paid $40 (Good Sam, Aug), $42 (weekly, Sep), $24 and $32 (Passport America). No gateway within 40 km (family home 205 km); the family has not stayed. Presence: working website with phone 319-800-9968 (matches stored and Google). Google Maps 4.2 (209 reviews); RV Life 4.5 stars, $$ (avg_rate 24), 5 reviews in 2026, all 8-10. Reads as passing.

LONG-STAY: the operator offers 'Seasonal Sites ... Call 319-800-9968', weekly $245 + electric and monthly $575 + electric; reviews on its own page mention 'our seasonal stays ... year after year' and a 4-month stay in 2019, and golf carts are 'for seasonal guests only'. But it posts the nightly rate first, takes online requests, and all five RV Life reviews (Jul-Sep 2026) are transient stays (1 week or less) on numbered sites (1, 17, 42, 80). I can't count the seasonal share; I read it as a transient park with a seasonal side, not mostly seasonal.

WATERFRONT LEAD DOWN, lakefront -> lakeview. The operator's site map (lakeshoreiowa.com/s/map.jpeg) puts every numbered site (1-104, A-E) south of its swim beach, picnic shelter and lawn, with Lake Oelwein along the top; on imagery the park's northernmost pads are ~65-80 m from the shoreline across that beach, volleyball/gaga courts, pavilion and lawn (imagery estimates; Overpass and Nominatim were down/refused). Its own swim beach is day use, so none of the mapped sites is on-water; the lake is in open view from the north rows, which supports lakeview. A separate row of ~25 back-in pads right on the shore 150-400 m to the north-west (where the stored pin sits) is reached by a paved road from the west, does not connect to the park's gravel loops on imagery, and is NOT on the operator's site map; Google lists no other campground there. If that row belongs to Lakeshore (an expansion newer than the map), it would hold on-water candidates (pad tails ~15-40 m from the water across open grass). Unconfirmed, so down.

PIN: stored 42.65050,-91.92050 sits on that unmapped shore row, ~250 m north of the park's loops. The mapped park's centre is ~42.6483,-91.9200 (Google's pin 42.6474,-91.9226 is the entrance/office). Suggest 42.6483,-91.9200 unless the shore row is shown to be the park's.

SITES: the derived pull_through stays (RV Life reviewers on 'pull_through' sites 1 and 80; the operator's pages don't say). The map numbers 104 sites plus A-E and a 'Mobile Home 105'; no count written, since the seasonal share and what A-E are aren't stated.
POLICIES worth knowing (not drop reasons): no refunds once a deposit is paid; visitors limited and charged a daily fee; 'No aggressive breeds permitted'.
